reply.text:
Nothing's logged for bench yet in your history, so I can't point to where it's actually stalling - the weight, the rep range, or just motivation.

In general, a bench stall usually comes from one of three places: you're grinding the same weight without changing stimulus (time to vary rep ranges or add pause work), your triceps or upper back are the weak link, or you're not actually recovering between sessions. Log a few sessions and I can tell you which one it looks like for you. Until then, what's the sticking point feel like - weight not moving at all, or reps dropping off?
